fields.name: Cipher Key
fields.description: Ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data (CipherKey): 0 = not requested, 1 = requested

notes: The Additional information requested information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.3.55.1 and table 9.9.3.55.1
The Additional information requested is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets

Ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data (CipherKey) (octet 2, bit 1): 0 = ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data not requested, 1 = ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested
Bits 8 to 2 of octet 2 are spare and shall be coded as zero
